test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the diameter of a circle is 14 cm, find the area of the sector of the circle whose central angle measure 60 degree.
solution:
**Given**

Radius = 14 / 2 cm and central angle = 60°

**Formula used:**

Area of sector whose central angle is θ = (πr² / 360) × θ

**Calculation**

⇒ (πr2 / 360) × 60

⇒ 22/7 × 7 × 7 × (1/6)

⇒ 154 / 6

⇒ 25.66 cm²

**∴ The area is 25.66 cm²**
